figures.caption: Figure 1: Overview of the pipeline architecture. Each channel is tokenized separately, and random channel subsets are dropped during training. Local views are short temporal crops, while global views are long temporal crops. The student receives both view types, the teacher receives only global views, and the objective matches their representations of the same segment.

Figure 2: The reconstruction pipeline. After alignment, EEG representations are mapped to the CLAP audio embedding space using ridge regression. The transformed embedding is then used to condition AudioLDM for music reconstruction.
Table 1: Reconstruction and alignment evaluation with the benchmark NMED-T and NMED-H datasets.

Figure 3: Channel attention patterns across songs. (a) Per-song maps for six representative songs from NMED-H (top) and NMED-T (bottom), plotted on the 10-10 scalp layout. (b) Pairwise dissimilarity between the 14 per-song maps as 1 - Pearson correlation.

Table 3: Encoder architecture and pretraining configuration. The left block lists the architecture and channel-oriented design parameters. The right block lists the multi-view self-distillation pretraining hyperparameters.
